SPECIFICATIONS
GRAND CARAVAN EXPRESS INCLUDES: 3.6L Pentastar® V6 Flex Fuel engine • 6-speed automatic • Electronic Stability Control (ESC)[5] • 4-wheel
ABS brakes • Rear defroster • Fuel optimizer calibration • Black belt molding • Body-color door handles • Black, foldaway, power heated mirrors •
16-inch wheel covers • Speed control • Remote keyless entry • Tire pressure monitoring. OPTIONAL FEATURES: Engine block heater • Mopar running
boards (only available in select colors) • Stow ’N PlaceTM Roof Rack • SIRIUS® Satellite Radio[3] • Mopar Exterior Appearance Group — Mopar Bright
Door Sills, Mopar Body-Color Running Boards, Mopar Splash Guards (only available in select colors), and Mopar Premium Floor Mats • Power Window
Group — Power front and second-row windows with one-touch up/down on front windows and power third-row vents • Uconnect® Hands-Free Group —
Leather-wrapped shift knob and steering wheel, auto-dimming rearview mirror, and SIRIUS Satellite Radio.[3]
GRAND CARAVAN MAINSTREET INCLUDES: All Grand Caravan Express equipment plus (or replaced with) Exterior/Functional — Body-color,
foldaway, power heated mirrors • 16-inch aluminum wheels and tires • Power front- and second-row windows with one-touch up/down on front
windows and power third-row vents. OPTIONAL FEATURES: Engine block heater • Mopar Running Boards (only available in select colors) • Stow ’N Place
Roof Rack • Premium removable sliding floor console • Media Center 430 • SIRIUS Satellite Radio[3] • Entertainment Group #1 — 9-inch overhead
screen, wireless headphones, wireless remote control, 115V power inverter, SIRIUS Satellite Radio[3] and Media Center 430 • Mopar Exterior
Appearance Group — Mopar Bright Door Sills, Mopar Body-Color Running Boards, Mopar Splash Guards (only available in select colors), and Mopar
Premium Floor Mats • Power Convenience Group #1 — Dual power sliding side doors, power liftgate, and power adjustable pedals • Security Group —
Security alarm and remote start system • Uconnect Hands-Free Group — Leather-wrapped shift knob and steering wheel, auto-dimming rearview
mirror, and SIRIUS Satellite Radio.[3]
GRAND CARAVAN CREW INCLUDES: All Grand Caravan Mainstreet equipment plus (or replaced with) Exterior/Functional — Bright belt molding • Dual power
sliding side doors • Fog lamps • Bright Stow ’N Place Roof Rack side rails • 17-inch aluminum wheels and tires. OPTIONAL FEATURES: Engine block
heater • Load-leveling and height-control suspension • Power liftgate • Mopar Running Boards (only available in select colors) • Premium removable
sliding floor console • Media Center 430N • Media Center 730N • Infinity® Acoustic 9TM speaker system with 506-watt amplifier • Driver Convenience
Group — Heated steering wheel, heated front seats, and Uconnect Phone • Entertainment Group #1 — Dual 9-inch overhead screens, wireless
headphones, wireless remote control, 115V power inverter, SIRIUS Satellite Radio,[3] and Media Center 730N • Mopar Exterior Appearance Group —
Mopar Bright Door Sills, Mopar Body-Color Running Boards, Mopar Splash Guards (only available in select colors), and Mopar Premium Floor Mats •
Passenger Convenience Group — Second- and third-row retractable window shades, heated second-row seats, and portable rechargeable trouble
lamp • Safety Sphere Group — Rain-sensitive wipers, automatic headlamps, ParkSense® Rear Park Assist,[7] Blind Spot Monitoring,[7] and Rear Cross
Path Detection[7] • Security Group — Security alarm and remote start system • Trailer Tow Prep Group — Heavy-duty engine cooling, trailer tow wiring
harness, and load-leveling and height-control suspension. Additional Dodge Towing Accessories may be required.
GRAND CARAVAN R/T (LATE AVAILABILITy) INCLUDES: All Grand Caravan Mainstreet equipment plus (or replaced with) Exterior/Functional —
Performance-tuned suspension • Dual power sliding side doors • Fog lamps • Body-color grille • 17-inch polished aluminum wheels and tires.
OPTIONAL FEATURES: Engine block heater • Load-leveling and height-control suspension • Power liftgate • Mopar Running Boards (only available in
select colors) • Stow ’N Place Roof Rack • Premium removable sliding floor console • Media Center 430N or 730N • Driver Convenience Group —
Heated steering wheel, heated front seats, and Uconnect Phone • Entertainment Group #1 — 9-inch overhead screens, wireless headphones,
wireless remote control, 115V power inverter, SIRIUS Satellite Radio[3] and Media Center 730N • Mopar Exterior Appearance Group — select exterior
Mopar options (only available in select colors) • Passenger Convenience Group — Second- and third-row retractable window shades, heated second-row seats,
and portable, rechargeable trouble lamp • Safety Sphere Group — Rain-sensitive wipers, automatic headlamps, ParkSense Rear Park Assist,[7] Blind
Spot Monitoring,[7] and Rear Cross Path Detection[7] • Security Group — Security alarm and remote start system • Trailer Tow Prep Group — Heavy-
duty engine cooling, trailer tow wiring harness, and load-leveling and height-control suspension. Additional Dodge Towing Accessories may be required.
